svg.title: Archisman Chakraborty | GitHub profile
svg.desc: GitHub profile banner for Archisman Chakraborty (Zenith, @AlgorithSage), with an ASCII portrait of him in sunglasses. Tagline: I turn chaos into code. Project Head at IEM Research Foundation, Research Intern at IEEE EMBS Pune, Lead at AlgoZenith Studio. B.Tech CSE at IEM Kolkata, CGPA 9.05. Achievements: winner at AI Posteria and Genspark 2.0 2026, Top 106 nationally in Google Solution Challenge 2026, Top 50 at SIH 2026 internal hackathon. Currently building CureBird, Oryonix AI, ProgyNova AI and Adorini.
